prompt: Without looking at any images, describe the most iconic image of Laughing Nailong (大笑奶龙 / 奶蛙) from memory: its pose, expression, body shape, colors, rendering style, and background, in enough detail for an artist who has never seen it to draw it. Say where you are unsure.
answer:
From memory, the image usually called “大笑奶龙” or “奶蛙” shows Nailong facing almost straight toward the viewer in a very low sit or squat. His short legs are spread broadly to either side, making the silhouette resemble a seated frog—hence “奶蛙.” His tiny forearms are bent near the front of his round belly, though I am not certain whether the best-known frame has them raised or resting lower.

The expression is the focal point: his head tilts slightly back, his eyes are squeezed shut into black curved slits, and his mouth opens into an exaggerated, broad laugh. The mouth interior is very dark reddish-brown or nearly black, with a pink-red tongue; small pale teeth may be visible, but I am unsure of their exact number and placement. His cheeks look puffed upward, and the nose is reduced to two small nostrils above the mouth.

His body is an extremely plump, neckless pear or bean shape, with an oversized rounded head flowing directly into the torso. The limbs and feet are stubby and soft, with rounded toes. A short thick tail and small dinosaur-like back details may be visible depending on the crop, but the frontal pose hides much of them.

The character is predominantly saturated lemon or golden yellow, with a lighter creamy-yellow belly and muzzle area. The rendering is smooth 3D CGI: soft, rubbery or toy-like surfaces, rounded forms, gentle shadows, and no drawn outlines. The meme is often presented as a cutout on white or a transparent/plain background. I vaguely associate some source frames with a bright outdoor setting—green ground and pale blue sky—but I would not rely on that; the isolated white-background version is the one I remember most clearly.
